description: Revolut X helps ChatGPT look up the signed-in user's exchange balances and working/finished orders, inspect a single order and its fills, and read live market catalog, tickers, candles, order-book depth, and public trades. It can also prepare a prefilled order-form link. It does not place, replace, or cancel orders.

defaultPrompt: Help me check my Revolut X balances
Show me current prices for BTC and ETH
